_about: Arc 1, the Birthday: the SKELETON only (rule H36; the chapters, goals and errands are docs/game-design/story-and-arcs.md 'Arc 1: The Birthday' as written; no new content). The beat script is still to write (story-and-arcs.md 'Arc 1's beat script: TBC'), so every beat is an id with status to-write and no line: lines are meanings in the language engine's data, never text here (G13). Format: docs/architecture/building-games.md 'Add an arc'. flow is the order a chapter plays in: {beat}, {errand: {id, mode, entry, settings, status}}, {conversation: {id}} (a slot where the shell MAY put a Conversation, H44). opens: what finishing the chapter opens (map places, modes; fed to js/core/unlocks.js through js/shared/mode.js withArcRules). Errand status: playable (its mode runs on the game host: Cook since R4, js/cook/main.js), waiting (the mode is built but not yet moved onto the host), to-build (no mode yet). note: for grown-ups and sessions only, never shown to the child.
source: rule H36; docs/game-design/story-and-arcs.md, Arc 1: The Birthday (28 Sept 2026)
